Checkbox_AutoRezOutOfParty: Apply to Out of Party Members
Checkbox_BypassSelfUse: Bypass When Combo Suggests Self-Use Action
Checkbox_OnlyAttackInCombat: Only Attack Targets Already In Combat
Checkbox_PreEmptiveHoT: [{0}/{1}/{2}/{3}] Pre-emptively apply Heal Over Time/Shields on focus target
HelpText_AoEHealTargetCount: Disabling this will turn off AoE Healing features. Otherwise will require the amount of targets required to be in range of an AoE feature's heal to use.
HelpText_AoETargetCount: Disabling this will turn off AoE DPS features. Otherwise will require the amount of targets required to be in range of an AoE feature's attack to use. This applies to all 3 roles, and for any features that deal AoE damage.
HelpText_AutoCleanse: Will {0} any cleansable debuffs (Healing takes priority).
HelpText_AutoRez:
Will attempt to resurrect dead party members.
Applies to {0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, {4}, and {5} ({6}/{7})
HelpText_AutoRezDPSJobs: When playing as {0} or {1}, also attempt to raise a dead party member. {2} will only resurrect with {3} or {4} active.
HelpText_AutoRezDPSJobsHealersOnly: When playing as {0} or {1}, Will only attempt to res Healers and Raisers
HelpText_AutoRezRequireSwift: Requires {0} or {1}'s {2} to be available to resurrect a party member, to avoid hard-casting.
HelpText_BypassFATETargets: Disables Auto-Mode outside of combat unless you're synced to a FATE.
HelpText_BypassQuestTargets: Disables Auto-Mode outside of combat unless you're within range of a quest target.
HelpText_BypassSelfUse: Many jobs have an out of combat action that can be used, for example, {0} or {1}. This will allow these to be used without being in combat.
HelpText_DPSAlwaysHardTarget: Auto-rotation does not need to target enemies to work, however with this setting enabled it will always set your hard target when it executes an attack.
HelpText_DPSMaxTargetDistance: Max distance all targeting modes (except Manual) will look for a target. Values from 1 to 30 only.
HelpText_DPSTargettingMode:
Manual - Leaves all targeting decisions to you.
Highest Max - Prioritises enemies with the highest max HP.
Lowest Max - Prioritises enemies with the lowest max HP.
Highest Current - Prioritises the enemy with the highest current HP.
Lowest Current - Prioritises the enemy with the lowest current HP.
Tank Target - Prioritises the same target as the first tank in your group.
Nearest - Prioritises the closest target to you.
Furthest - Prioritises the furthest target from you.
HelpText_EnforceBestAoETarget: For all other targeting modes, AoE will target based on highest number of targets hit. In manual mode, it will only do this if you tick this box.
HelpText_HandleRaidwides: Will try to use actions before detected raidwides or group damage to either mitigate or top-off party members. Max 3 actions (excluding {0} for setup)
HelpText_HandleTankbusters: Will try to use actions before detected tankbusters to mitigate damage on targeted member. Max 1 action (excluding {0} for setup)
HelpText_HealDelay: Don't set this too high! 1-2 seconds is normally comfy enough to be considered a natural reaction.
HelpText_HealerAlwaysHardTarget: Auto-rotation does not need to target allies to work, however with this setting enabled it will always set your hard target when it executes a heal.
HelpText_HealerTargetingMode:
Manual - Will only heal a target if you select them manually. If the target does not meet the healing threshold settings criteria below it will skip healing in favour of DPSing (if also enabled).
Highest Current - Prioritises the party member with the highest current HP%.
Lowest Current - Prioritises the party member with the lowest current HP%.
HelpText_IgnoreRangeInBoss: When in boss fights only, any target regardless of distance can be eligible to be attacked.
HelpText_IgnoredNPCs:
These NPCs will be ignored by Auto-Rotation.
Every instance of this NPC will be excluded from automatic targeting (Manual will still work).
To remove an NPC from this list, select it and press the Delete button below.
To add an NPC to this list, target the NPC and use the command: /wrath ignore
HelpText_IncludeNPCs: Useful for healer quests where NPCs are expected to be healed but aren't added directly to your party.
HelpText_ManageKardia: Switches {0} to party members currently being targeted by enemies, prioritising tanks if multiple people are being targeted.
HelpText_Orbwalker: This will make Auto-Rotation use actions with cast times even whilst moving, as Orbwalker will lock movement during the cast. You may need to enable "Buffer Initial Cast" setting in Orbwalker if not already enabled. Requires an Orbwalker plugin to be installed and enabled.
HelpText_PreEmptiveHoT: Applies {0}/{1}/{2}/{3} to your focus target when out of combat and they are 30y or less away from an enemy. (Bypasses "Restrict to Combat Only" setting)
HelpText_QueueWindow: This will determine how soon before the GCD is finished to queue up the next weaponskill or spell. Your latency may have an effect on what actions are performed so please adjust this if you're noticing improper action use, i.e double Blizzard IV casts due to MP not updating in time.
HelpText_SingleTargetExcogHPP: You typically want to set this lower than the above setting.
HelpText_SingleTargetRegenHPP: You typically want to set this lower than the above setting.
HelpText_ThrottleDelay: Auto-Rotation has a built in throttler to only run every so many milliseconds for performance reasons. If you experience issues with frame rate, try increasing this value. Do note this may have a side-effect of introducing clipping if set too high, so experiment with the value.
HelpText_TreasureHuntPriority: When enemies have numbered nameplate markers (1–5), Auto-Rotation will only attack the lowest remaining number until it dies. Used for treasure map vermin; also applies anywhere those markers appear.
HelpText_UnTargetAndDisableForPenalty: This will un-set any current target and disable Auto-Rotation actions if there is a current detected action penalty, such as Pyretics (or similar, like Acceleration Bomb) affecting the player, that would harm them if they took any action.
Include_Shields_Helptext: Includes shield% in all HP checks.
Info_Header:
This is where you can configure the parameters in which Auto-Rotation will operate.
Features marked with an 'Auto-Mode' checkbox are able to be used with Auto-Rotation.
Input_AoEHealTargetCount: Targets Required for AoE Healing Features
Input_AoETargetCount: Targets Required for AoE Damage Features
Input_AutoRotationDelay: Delay to activate Auto-Rotation once combat starts (seconds)
Input_HealDelay: Delay to start healing once above conditions are met (seconds)
Label_IgnoreRangeInBoss: Ignore Max Target Distance In Boss Fights
OnlyAoEManualTargetSet: Only AoE When Manual Target is Set
OnlyAoEManualTargetSetHelp: Will still AoE on the best target, but only after you've set a hard target first (this may be switched to the best target afterwards).
PauseNoTarget: Pause Actions from Combos When No Target Selected
PauseNoTargetHelp: Pauses all actions that would come from combos if there is no target selected with the selected targeting mode. Ideal for blocking self-use actions if no target is available.
Slider_SingleTargetExcogHPP: Single Target HP% Threshold (target has Excogitation)
Slider_SingleTargetRegenHPP: Single Target HP% Threshold (target has Regen/Aspected Benefic)
